title: QML-IDS Operating Points: reproducibility artifact for the Kaissar corpus
description:
Portable derived-data and software companion for False-Alarm Improvements and Detection Trade-Offs in QML Intrusion Detection: A Secondary Analysis of the Kaissar Corpus. The closed 25-entry frame yields 21 included articles (20 identified documentary families), with substantive methodological material consulted for 15. Five articles supply 24 main descriptive points; ten points from three articles enter the principal conditional binomial analysis.

The package preserves 466 derived records, source/version locations, deterministic calculations, independent numerical checks and figure/table generation. It distinguishes K17 descriptive comparisons, K10 separately identifiable FPR, K07 identification ranges, K03 observed versus conditional rates and K11 training-described results. No primary document copies, manuscript PDFs, journal template, model training or QPU execution are included.
